title: Electrical — Essential Network and Emergency Generation

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Flight crew description of the essential electrical network, covering what remains powered after the loss of all generators and how long the crew can expect it to last.

sections.purpose: This entry describes the essential electrical network as it matters to the flight crew: what stays powered when the generators are lost, in what order things are shed, and what the crew can expect in terms of endurance.
sections.description: The electrical system feeds a small essential network that is designed to survive the loss of every generator. On the loss of all generation the emergency generator deploys and takes the essential loads; the battery covers the gap while it comes on line and covers the whole essential network if the emergency generator is not available. What remains powered is a defined list, and the crew sees it as a reduced set of displays, one radio, the standby instruments and the flight controls in their degraded law. Non-essential loads drop automatically and there is no crew action to shed them. The endurance the crew may plan on is given in the limitations section and assumes the battery is at its scheduled capacity and that nothing outside the essential list is drawing from it. It is a shorter time than most crews expect and it is the figure that sets the diversion planning on a long over-water or polar sector, which is why it appears in the flight planning section as well as here.
sections.crew_procedure: On the loss of all generators, follow the ECAM actions and confirm that the emergency generator has come on line. Note the time. Plan the diversion on the endurance figure from the limitations section and not on an estimate. Do not attempt to restore a non-essential bus to recover an item that has been shed; the shedding is what the endurance figure assumes. Where the emergency generator is available, the battery endurance is not the limiting factor and the normal diversion planning applies.

type_data.crew_action: ECAM actions, confirm emergency generation, plan the diversion on the published endurance figure.
